description:

**Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited** is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

title: Oracle DBA
description:
Job Title: Oracle DBA

City: Coimbatore

State/Province: Tamil Nadu

Posting Start Date: 10/8/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

**Location:** **Chennai, Coimbatore, Pune, Bengaluru, Greater Noida (GNDC), and Hyderabad.**

**Core Responsibilities**

* Administer and support Oracle databases across production and non-production environments.

* Manage and troubleshoot Oracle RAC, Data Guard, ASM, and Grid Infrastructure.

* Perform SQL and database performance tuning using AWR, ASH, and execution plan analysis.

* Execute backup, recovery, and recovery validation using RMAN.

* Implement Oracle security controls, including access management, TDE, and SQL encryption.

* Perform database and Grid Infrastructure patching and upgrades using OPatch, OPatchAuto, DataPatch, and Release Updates.

* Support database migrations, platform upgrades, refreshes, and cloud transformation initiatives.

* Develop and troubleshoot SQL, PL/SQL, Shell, and automation scripts.

* Support incidents, root cause analysis, change execution, and problem management.

* Maintain runbooks and standards, and drive automation and continuous improvement.

**Platform / Technical Scope**

* Oracle Database 12c, 19c, and 21c

* Oracle RAC, Data Guard, ASM, and Grid Infrastructure

* RMAN and Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM)

* SQL, PL/SQL, TDE, and Oracle security

* OPatch, OPatchAuto, DataPatch, and Release Updates

* Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Oracle Linux

* AWS, Azure, or OCI experience preferred

Present changes for approval with rollback plans in change approval meetings. Execute approved changes and document post-implementation outcomes."

Contribute towards development of mitigation action to reduce repeat incidents, by identifying patterns of issues noted."

title: Office Administrator
description:
Vision India Insurance is looking for a responsible, organized, and proactive OfficeAdministrator to join our team in Coimbatore.

The selected candidate will be responsible for managing internal systems and records, maintaining agent and customer data, coordinating daily operational activities, monitoring recruitment and onboarding processes, and supporting the team with administrative and system-related tasks.

This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with Microsoft Excel, WhatsApp, Google Forms, databases, and office tools, has strong coordination and follow-up skills, and can efficiently manage multiple tasks while maintaining accurate records.

Important: This is a full-time, office-based position. Work From Home is not available.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Communicate with existing customers and provide professional assistance.
* Understand customer requirements and collect relevant information.
* Handle customer queries and service-related concerns.
* Provide appropriate information and assistance based on customer requirements.
* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, interactions, and transactions.
* Conduct timely follow-ups with customers.
* Maintain professional and positive customer relationships.

**System Administration & Operations**

* Manage and update WhatsApp Status and other team communication requirements.
* Receive, organize, and distribute leads to Telecalling Executives.
* Monitor pending applications and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Send Google Forms to new agents and track completion of required details and documents.
* Verify new agent applications and submitted documents.
* Coordinate branch verification for new agent applications.
* Monitor the agent onboarding process, including interviews, examinations, and first policy login.
* Upload and maintain daily data related to Telecaller appointments, Facebook leads, and field leads.
* Create and organize folders for LIC and Star Health licenses and insurance-related documents.
* Contact inactive agents to collect updated information.
* Maintain and update the agent master sheet.
* Track agent performance and success metrics using Excel.
* Maintain accurate internal databases and operational records.
* Manage and organize appointment letters and other important documents.
* Prepare and submit daily activity and operational reports.
* Identify opportunities to improve internal workflows and office processes.
* Coordinate with different teams to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
* Ensure important data and records are updated regularly and maintained systematically.

**Eligibility & Skills**

* Education: Any Degree / Relevant Qualification.
* Experience in System Administration, Office Administration, Operations, Data Management, or Coordination will be an added advantage.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, WhatsApp, Google Forms, and other office tools.
* Basic understanding of data management and record maintenance.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle customer and agent information accurately.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* Good problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities within deadlines.
* Experience with CRM software, databases, or agent onboarding systems will be an added advantage.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn new systems and processes.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of customer, agent, and company information.

**Key Skills**

Microsoft Excel | Data Management | System Administration | Google Forms | WhatsApp | Database Management | Documentation | Operations Coordination | Customer Support | Agent Onboarding | Follow-up | Reporting | Computer Skills

**Salary & Benefits**

* Attractive salary based on experience and skills.
* Performance-based incentives.
* Training and professional guidance.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Cell phone reimbursement.
* Commuter assistance.
* Supportive and professional work environment.

Working Hours

**Monday to Saturday**  
**9:00 AM – 6:30 PM**

**Work Location:** In person, Coimbatore

**Work Mode:** Full-time, Office-based

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance

Work Location: In person

title: Oracle Core DBA
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**Your Role**
-------------


We are seeking experienced **Oracle Database Administrators (Oracle DBA)** to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing, maintaining, monitoring, optimizing, and securing Oracle database environments while ensuring high availability, performance, and reliability of mission\-critical applications.


* Install, configure, administer, and maintain Oracle Database environments.
* Manage database upgrades, migrations, patches, and refresh activities.
* Monitor database performance and proactively identify optimization opportunities.
* Perform database tuning, SQL tuning, and performance troubleshooting.
* Manage backup and recovery strategies using RMAN.
* Configure and support High Availability (HA) solutions including RAC, Data Guard, and ASM.
* Implement database security standards, user management, and access controls.
* Perform capacity planning, storage management, and database health checks.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues within defined SLAs.
* Support application deployment, release management, and database changes.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and cloud teams to ensure seamless operations.
* Prepare and maintain operational documentation and SOPs.
* Hands\-on experience with: Oracle Database 12c, 19c, 21c or higher, Oracle RAC, Oracle Data Guard, Oracle ASM, RMAN Backup \& Recovery, Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM), Database Performance Tuning, SQL \& PL/SQL
* Experience in database patching, upgrades, cloning, and migration activities.
* Strong knowledge of database security, auditing, and compliance standards.
* Experience managing large\-scale production environments.
* Good understanding of Linux/Unix operating systems.
**What you'll love about working with us**
------------------------------------------


* We value flexibility and support a healthy work\-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Career development programs and certifications in cloud technologies.
* A diverse and inclusive workplace that fosters innovation and collaboration.
Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.


Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.
